description: This file defines a generic interface DataPopulator used for converting or populating data from a source object to a target object, with additional context provided via MerchantStore and Language parameters.

classes.name: DataPopulator
classes.description: A generic interface for populating or converting data between source and target objects, potentially involving external context like MerchantStore and Language.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts or populates data from the source object to the target object, considering store and language context. May throw ConversionException.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts or populates data from the source object to a new target object, considering store and language context. May throw ConversionException.
